questions.subject: Japanese
questions.prompt: What is the Japanese word for the number 19?

block.label: Scrub It
block.sub: Rub out the wrong answers with your finger

questions.why: 19 is juuku (juu + ku). Juuichi is 11, nijuu is 20, and kyuu alone is just 9 — the 'juu-' prefix shows it's a teen number.

questions.subject: Japanese
questions.prompt: What is the Japanese word for the number 500?

block.label: Scrub It
block.sub: Rub out the wrong answers with your finger

questions.why: Gohyaku (500) is go (5) plus hyaku (100) — larger numbers combine a digit with hyaku, sen, or man.
